knowledge_package.title: Precision Optical Dial Micrometer Zeroing
knowledge_package.summary: Standard procedure for cleaning anvil faces, verifying optical alignment under 50x magnification, and setting zero baseline.

claims.statement: Wipe measuring faces with optical lint-free paper using a single continuous drag motion.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Expert draws optical paper smoothly without scrubbing or back-and-forth friction.

claims.statement: Audible ratchet thimble must click exactly 3 times at uniform 0.5s cadence to apply standard 5N contact pressure.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Three distinct uniform ratchet clicks audible at 19.1s, 19.6s, 20.1s.

claims.statement: Lock barrel screw must only be engaged after needle settles completely within +/- 0.5 division indicator.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Indicator needle stabilizes at zero index line before thumb engages lock ring.

consent.notes: Approved for Google Cloud AI Builder Cup demonstration.

expert_review.notes: Step sequence and 3-click ratchet cadence are accurate.

rubric.title: Optical Micrometer Calibration Proficiency Rubric
rubric.description: Standardized criteria for optical micrometer face cleaning, spindle approach, and lock engagement.

criteria.name: Face Cleaning Motion
criteria.description: Single unidirectional drag motion using lint-free optical paper without circular or reciprocating scrubbing.
criteria.observable_indicator: Continuous unidirectional paper motion across anvil face.

criteria.name: Ratchet Speed and Click Count
criteria.description: Exactly three audible ratchet clicks applied at steady cadence between 0.3s and 0.8s intervals.
criteria.observable_indicator: Audible click audio waveform count equals 3.

criteria.name: Settled Lock Engagement
criteria.description: Spindle lock engaged only after gauge needle has come to a complete rest.
criteria.observable_indicator: Zero angular needle velocity at moment lock lever moves.

practice_task.title: Zero an Optical Dial Micrometer
practice_task.instructions: 1. Inspect optical faces and perform a single linear wipe with lint-free paper. 2. Advance spindle gently until ratchet stop engages. 3. Turn ratchet stop for exactly 3 steady clicks. 4. Wait for indicator needle to settle, then engage spindle lock lever.

constraints.description: Complete complete zeroing sequence within 45 seconds
Use 0-25mm optical dial micrometer with 0.001mm graduation

evidence.cue_excerpt: Learner scrubs paper back and forth, turns thimble barrel rapidly generating 7 fast clicks, locks while needle vibrating.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Paper moved back and forth repeatedly in scrubbing motion across optical faces.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Expert demonstrated single unidirectional wipe. Reciprocating motion traps abrasive dust.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Turned thimble barrel rapidly generating 7 clicks in under 0.8s.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Excessive click count and force induces elastic frame deflection exceeding 0.003mm.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Engaged lock lever while needle was still oscillating between +1 and -1 division.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Lock lever must only be applied after needle is fully stationary.

feedback.summary: Focus your retry on three physical adjustments: 1. Wipe once in one direction. 2. Turn ratchet stop for exactly 3 slow clicks. 3. Let needle settle before locking.

items.what_was_observed: You scrubbed the optical paper back and forth across the measuring faces.
items.what_differed: Expert dragged paper in a single unidirectional sweep to prevent re-depositing grit.
items.corrective_advice: Place paper between anvils, close gently, and pull paper straight out in one continuous movement.

items.what_was_observed: You spun the thimble rapidly producing 7 clicks.
items.what_differed: Expert turned ratchet stop slowly with fingertips to produce exactly 3 clicks at 0.5s cadence.
items.corrective_advice: Use thumb and forefinger on the small ratchet knurl only, counting 'click-one, click-two, click-three' then stop.

items.what_was_observed: You engaged the lock lever while the needle was still oscillating.
items.what_differed: Expert waited until needle was completely motionless at zero.
items.corrective_advice: Wait 1 full second after 3rd click. Ensure needle is stable before rotating the lock lever.

evidence.cue_excerpt: Learner pulls optical paper smoothly in single stroke, grips small ratchet knurl producing exactly 3 steady clicks, waits for needle to rest at 0 before locking.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Optical paper pulled straight through in single continuous unidirectional pass.
Turned ratchet knurl steadily producing exactly 3 audible clicks spaced 0.5s apart.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Cadence and click count match expert standard.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Paused after 3rd click; needle settled completely at 0 before lock lever engaged.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Zero angular needle deflection during lock engagement.

lineage.adaptation_notes: Learner achieved 100% competency across all three observable criteria on first retry following targeted feedback.
